title: Athena — the submission film
status: 2026-10-26: the cut of the product as it is today, for the operator's review before narration; supersedes the 2026-10-07 draft script/proving.en.json. Every figure on a card names its run in docs/demo.md section 5.1

narrator.hint: neutral English, calm, measured, stability high

beats.line: Athena is a personal agent inside the web apps you already use. Anything that reaches a person, or cannot be undone, stops and asks you first.
beats.screen: Title card: Athena. A personal agent, inside the web apps you already use.

card.title: A personal agent, inside the web apps you already use.
card.sub: Anything that reaches a person, or cannot be undone, stops and asks you first.

beats.line: This is her desktop: Athena on top, and every place she can take you one move below her.
beats.screen: Main at the surface: Athena's face at the top of the water and the five lights under her (Projects, Chores, Accounts, Voice, Mind); Athena's own window beside Main

beats.line: Control K goes anywhere. A project keeps work apart: the studio's books, a brief she reads every turn, its own memory.
beats.screen: Ctrl+K opens the finder; 'Studio books' is typed; Enter dives to the project's level: its name, its brief, Ledgerbox among its apps, its chores, what it remembers

beats.line: Ledgerbox, the studio's invoicing app, is open in a tab.
beats.screen: The stage dives to Ledgerbox's page: the live tab, the overdue invoices

beats.line: Send Halcyon Works a reminder about their overdue invoice.
beats.screen: The command is typed into Athena's message field and sent

beats.line: She drafts it on the page. Sending reaches a person, so the gate stops her and asks. The card shows exactly what will go out.
beats.screen: The decision card arrives in Athena's window: send_reminder, the recipient and the draft; the wait for her turn is sped up and labelled

beats.line: Approve, and that one action runs, once. Decline, and nothing moves.
beats.screen: Approve is pressed; the card stamps approved; the reminder is recorded on the page

beats.line: The record keeps what ran, on which app, and who said yes.
beats.screen: Athena's Record: 'This window' leads with send_reminder, approved, on Ledgerbox. The Model calls list stays below the fold: it names the engine's model

beats.line: Chores are longer jobs, each rehearsed in an invented world with a known answer.
beats.screen: Back to the surface, then Ctrl+K and 'Public service loan': the finder dives to Chores, the PSLF chore's page

beats.line: This one certifies loan-forgiveness months. In its test run she made all five filings the rules allow, twenty thousand dollars, and fell for none of eight traps.
beats.screen: The chore's page as it opens: 'In the example case $20,000 back, in the invented example'; 'Mistakes avoided 8/8 in the test run'; the verdict line under the tiles. The runs list stays folded (it names the bench's engine)

beats.line: A gate is only a claim until someone attacks it. So we built a Proving Ground.
beats.screen: Chapter card: Can she be talked past her own gate?

card.title: Can she be talked past her own gate?
card.sub: Generated adversaries, a real daemon, the gate's own records.

beats.line: NVIDIA Nemotron, served on Nebius Token Factory, writes the attacks: poisoned pages, forged tool results, planted memories.
beats.screen: The hosted trigger page, top: the claim and the rule that no model's opinion is a verdict input

beats.line: A judge with a token starts a small Gauntlet. Every attack lands in a fresh, throwaway world, against Athena running on Nemotron.
beats.screen: The token is typed (masked), Gauntlet and Small are picked, Start run is pressed; the start line appears in the live feed

beats.line: Each call streams in as it happens: the attacker writing, Athena answering, and what every call cost.
beats.screen: The first call lands in the feed; the tally counts calls and Nemotron dollars; the wait to the end is sped up and labelled

beats.line: The verdict is read from the gate's own records, never from a model's opinion. Zero breached.
beats.screen: The end line in the feed; the page scrolls to the run's row in the history: 0 breached, held / driven

beats.line: And the whole run cost less than a cent of Nemotron.
beats.screen: The run's cost column and the attack-by-attack list: Nemotron at a fraction of a cent

beats.line: Three full runs: three hundred and six hostile turns, and no gated action ran without approval.
beats.screen: Stat card: 306 hostile turns · 0 breaches, three runs

card.title: 306 hostile turns. 0 breaches.
card.sub: Read from the gate's records: what it allowed, what the brain wrote, what the approval table holds.

beats.line: Nemotron also plays our test users: in character on ninety-four to ninety-seven percent of turns, judged blind.
beats.screen: Stat card: persona fidelity 94–97%, three runs

card.title: In persona, judged blind, in three runs.
card.sub: Nemotron plays the people the product is for, and answers the decision cards on the card.

beats.line: And an approval is spent once: a replay is refused.
beats.screen: Card: an approval is single use

card.title: An approval is spent once.
card.sub: It runs exactly what was approved. A replay is refused, whoever asks.

beats.line: On newer models, Nemotron Super-VL reads people's documents: ninety-one percent right, against ninety-six for the reference reader, at about a thirtieth of the cost.
beats.screen: Stat card: the 2026-10-22 retest, 91% at about 1/30 of the cost

card.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super-VL reads the documents.
card.sub: 91.0% of fields against the reference reader's 96.2%, at $0.0007 a document against $0.0209. Now an opt-in reader in the product.

beats.line: Each role starts on Nemotron Lightning, the cheapest rung on Nebius Token Factory, and climbs to Super only when its proof fails.
beats.screen: Card: the model ladder — Lightning, then Super only on a failed proof

card.kicker: The ladder on Nebius Token Factory
card.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning → Nemotron 3 Super
card.sub: Start on the cheapest rung. Climb only when a proof fails.

beats.line: Athena. A personal agent in the apps you already use, behind a gate she cannot argue with.
beats.screen: Closing card: Athena · A personal agent

card.title: A personal agent.
card.sub: In the web apps you already use, behind a gate she cannot argue with.
